audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers gave Ryze Levels 1-2 and 'Skill' at 2+ items, but the packet levelChart is [Skill, Mordekaiser x5, Ryze] and the prose already contradicts the chart (whys[0] calls Level 1 'a wash', whys[6]/late/spikes[3] say Ryze takes over at two items).
audit.why: Ryze has no all-in and no dash at level 1; Rune Prison only roots through Spell Flux, so an unstacked Ryze can only slow. Conversely at 2+ items maxed Overload resets chain his roots and he kites Mordekaiser's melee aura — the page's own late/spikes text says so.
audit.corrected: Level 1 Skill; Levels 2 through 6 and first item Mordekaiser; 2+ items Ryze. Proposed as a matched full/content pair for every row.

audit.why: Spikes read Lvl 2-3 (Q+W), Lvl 6 (Realm of Death, 140/120/100s), 1st item, 2+ items (Ryze flips it). Four entries present, all real.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page repeatedly calls Rune Prison 'his point-blank root' with no condition attached. Riot's own text: Rune Prison slows, and only roots if Flux (Spell Flux, E) is already on the target. Overload being a first-target-hit projectile is also never stated.
audit.why: This is the decisive interaction of the matchup — it tells you exactly when to step in (before Spell Flux lands) instead of a vague 'bait it'. Overload stopping on the first enemy struck means a caster minion body-blocks his poke.
audit.corrected: Rune Prison roots only if Spell Flux is on you; clean it is a 615-range slow on a 9-11s cooldown. Overload stops on the first enemy hit, so a minion blocks it. Realm Warp is a 3000-range delayed team portal, not a dash, and cannot pull an ally out of the death realm.

audit.whatIsWrong: No real cooldown numbers on the punish window.
audit.why: Rune Prison is 11/10.5/10/9.5/9s — a concrete engage clock.
audit.corrected: Engage on Rune Prison's 9-11s cooldown, and before Spell Flux (2.5-3.5s) reapplies.

edits.before: Q start, but it's slow and telegraphed — Ryze dodges it on reaction at full HP. Last-hit, aim isolated Qs only when he commits to a CS.
edits.after: Q start is slow and telegraphed, but Ryze is immobile with no all-in either — farm even and land isolated Qs only when he steps up to a CS.

edits.before: W banks a cut of the damage you deal and take as shield-health. Short Q-auto trades now come out even or better because half the return damage gets absorbed.
edits.after: W banks a cut of the damage you deal and take as shield-health, so short Q-auto trades now beat his Overload poke — step up the moment you hit 2 and force them.

edits.before: Riftmaker omnivamp turns the Realm 1v1 unloseable into most matchups. Ryze's only outs are dodging Q forever or never being alone — neither survives a whole game.
edits.after: Ryze reclaims it at two items: maxed Overload resets off Spell Flux chain his roots from 615 range and kite your aura, so close the game out before this lands.

edits.before: - Ryze Rune Prison: matchup-defining — His point-blank root — sets up his combo. Bait it. Track it before every engage.
edits.after: - Ryze Rune Prison: it roots only if Spell Flux is on you; clean it is a slow. Engage on its 9-11s cooldown.

edits.before: His point-blank root — sets up his combo. Bait it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Rune Prison roots only if Spell Flux is on you; clean it is a slow. Engage before his E.

edits.before: That is Ryze's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Overload stops on the first thing it hits — hold behind a caster minion, not chasing.

edits.before: Track Ryze's Rune Prison: His point-blank root — sets up his combo. Bait it. When it is down — E-pull + Q, then R the 1v1.
edits.after: Rune Prison roots only if Spell Flux hit you first — clean, it is just a slow. Engage before his E, then E-pull + Q and R the 1v1.
